description: California Secretary of State Shirley Weber knows all too well how the race for voting rights is an intergenerational marathon. She’s the proud daughter of sharecroppers and is the first Black person to hold the position in California after Gov. Gavin Newsom nominated her at the end of 2020.
title: [NBC News] How 3 Black women secretaries of state are protecting voting rights - Shirley Weber for Secretary of State
